feeds.title: Atlantic Pacific
feeds.description: Hi, my name is Blair Eadie and I am the owner and operator of the personal style site Atlantic-Pacific. I began Atlantic-Pacific in 2010 as a passion project to document my east-coast-meets-west-coast style aesthetic. My photographs have allowed me to tell an ongoing narrative of my evolving personal style. I love all things feminine - think timeless meets classic with a hint of quirk.

feeds.title: We Wore What
feeds.description: Covers everything from fashion to interior design to menswear, your single-source destination for the delectable world of Danielle. WeWoreWhat provides up-to-date info on the nightlife-leading, plant-slutting, Frenchie-coveting entrepreneur.

feeds.title: Extra Petite
feeds.description: Extra Petite is a fashion and lifestyle blog by Jean that provides styling ideas and shopping information. This blog also aims to share fashion suggestions and solutions for women who want to look stylish and feel confident at any height or size. Her style is still very office friendly most of the time, while also being very colourful and on-trend.

feeds.title: Inside Out Style Blog
feeds.description: Style Tips for Tall Women. Imogen Lamport is a certified Image consultant and personal stylist. Helping all women of every stage and age, size and shape discover the clothes and style that suits them with easy, practical everyday style solutions.

feeds.title: Busbee Style
feeds.description: Hi, I am Erin. My goal is to make style simple and attainable for busy women like you. That means lots of 'real' outfit posts to give you styling ideas. This blog focuses on Easy Style Tips and Shopping Suggestions for Busy Women Over 40.

feeds.title: Sincerely Jules
feeds.description: I'm Julie (a.k.a Jules), welcome to my little world, Sincerely Jules, where you'll see bits and pieces of my outfits, my fun travels, my favorite products, my beauty tips & tricks, parts of my home, sneak peeks of cool collabs, launches + more! Sincerely Jules is my happy place where I love to share parts of my life with you and bring you along for the ride!

feeds.title: Styl.Inc
feeds.description: We are Image Consultant/Personal Stylist & Wedding Shoppers here in India who are determined to make a fashionable yet stylish difference in the Wardrobes & Lifestyles of people!

feeds.title: 9to5Chic
feeds.description: I am Anh, wife of an OCD cutie, and mother to a little girl named Lucia.9to5Chic. This is my way of expressing my personal style at work. But it wouldn't be a personal style diary unless I shared some fun weekend outfits when I'm off the clock too.

feeds.title: Stylish Curves
feeds.description: The blog aims to give the curvy plus size woman a different perspective on fashion by showing them how to shop within and outside the plus size realm to get celebrity looks and to create their own personal style.

feeds.title: Fashion Steele NYC
feeds.description: Monroe Steele founded Fashion Steele NYC in 2010, it has since become a staple in the New York City fashion scene. Fashion Steele NYC is a personal fashion, lifestyle and travel website where luxury, thrift and high street meet that showcases her life and shopping experiences in New York City.

feeds.title: Penny Pincher Fashion
feeds.description: Penny Pincher Fashion has become synonymous with style on a budget. Kimberly is known for her closet creativity and her innate ability to stretch her dollars. She is passionate about finding the best fashion and beauty for less and helping you make the most of your wardrobe without breaking the bank.

feeds.title: Disneyrollergirl
feeds.description: Disneyrollergirl, the fashion blog by London-based fashion editor, Navaz Batliwalla. As a freelance fashion editor and consultant, the blog is my place to park all the things I see, hear and think about on my daily fashion beat. Disneyrollergirl is the go-to resource for fashion and beauty industry insights, emerging trends and editorial shoots from an industry insider's point of view.

feeds.title: Magali Vaz
feeds.description: My name is Magali & welcome to my eponymous blog. I post about beauty, personal style, my travels, tech, food & other lifestyle content.

feeds.title: Keiko Lynn
feeds.description: A very personal take on beauty, beauty tips, style, and general musings by Keiko Lynn. You can get to know her on this site, where she shares a peek into her daily life, style, and beauty tips.

feeds.title: Coco's Tea Party
feeds.description: Coco's Tea Party is a British fashion and lifestyle blog dedicated to providing attainable style inspiration for fashionable Women. It is a leading lifestyle blog providing attainable style inspiration for fashion-savvy young professionals. This blog covers fashion, beauty, skincare, makeup, living and more for women.

feeds.title: Meganlarussa Blog
feeds.description: Personal Fashion Stylist Megan LaRussa is most trusted Style Coach in USA. She is one of top Image Consultants for women.

feeds.title: Stella's Wardrobe
feeds.description: I love fashion. I keep a photographic diary of my outfits. I have a blog.

feeds.title: The Outfit Repeater Blog
feeds.description: The Outfit Repeater is a personal style blog focused on thrifted, vintage & affordable fashion. It's a space for inspiration and tips on how to repeat your closet, rewear a decade, and rework your secondhand finds.

feeds.title: StyldLife | Personal Hair, Makeup and Fashion Stylists
feeds.description: StyldLife is a beauty/lifestyle platform where clients from around the world book remote styling appointments with international celebrity and professional hair stylists, makeup artists and fashion stylists. StyldLife stylists will guide you through the prosess, step-by-step. Read throughts and musings from StyldLife hair, makeup and fashion stylists.

feeds.title: Summer Wind
feeds.description: Pittsburgh based life and style blog by Sydney Carver, that boasts classic, timeless style with preppy influences and a ladylike twist.

feeds.title: StyleyourselfHub
feeds.description: StyleyourselfHub is a growing Indian Beauty and Recipes blog covering DIY tutorial, Makeup, Skin Care, Hair Care, Reviews, Health, Hairstyles and Nail Art.

feeds.title: StyleScrapbook
feeds.description: I started StyleScrapbook over 7 years ago because of a need to share my dreams, my goals and my story.

feeds.title: The Chriselle Factor
feeds.description: Stylist and Digital Influencer, Chriselle Lim has been creating quite a stir in the fashion industry. Starting off her fashion career as a wardrobe stylist, she logged in years of editorial shoots with prominent fashion books and celebrities.

feeds.title: Native Fox
feeds.description: Jennifer Grace is a creative director and stylist based out of Southern California. This blog covers her personal style and fashion.

feeds.title: Girl With Curves
feeds.description: Covers everything from trends, style tips, beauty advice, parenting, wellness, self-esteem, body image, motherhood and much more and also solving style and beauty problems. Founded in 2011 by Tanesha Awasthi, Girl With Curves is an award-winning blog made possible by people who believe women deserve to look and feel beautiful, regardless of weight, shape or size.

feeds.title: Sea of Shoes
feeds.description: Jane Aldridge is one of the earliest pioneers of the personal styling space, having launched her industry-adored blog in 2007. Sea of Shoes covers everything from editorial photography and lifestyle content, pretty clothes to Women's style, outfits, beauty, fitness travel and more.

feeds.title: The Rachel Parcell Blog
feeds.description: We're a creative, fashion, and lifestyle brand founded in 2016. Rachel herself is our CEO and Creative Director -devoted mom, wife, sister, designer, and blogger of all things pink, pretty, and RP-approved. Through her namesake collections, creative content, and personalized brand partnerships, Rachel curates chic and romantic inspiration for your wardrobe, celebrations, travel, home décor, and individual style.

feeds.title: Top Trends Guide
feeds.description: In this blog, you will get the latest men's and women's fashion and style trends. Featuring the top brands, fashion guides, grooming tips, hairstyles, tattoos, beauty advice, nail designs, outfit ideas, and more!

feeds.title: The Frugality
feeds.description: A Freelance Fashion Stylist working and living in London. This blog is not about living off toast every night. This is an affordably stylish guide to dressing well.

feeds.title: Lauren Messiah Blog
feeds.description: Lauren Messiah is a personal stylist based in Los Angeles and the President of School of Style.

feeds.title: eat.sleep.wear.
feeds.description: Covers fashion tips, trends, and advice that celebrates personal style, photography, and everyday inspirations of fashion.

feeds.title: Le Fashion
feeds.description: Le Fashion covers the latest in trends, street style, beauty and editorials, while also sharing style inspiration, ways to get the looks and my latest shopping picks.

feeds.title: The Werk! Place - Personal Style Blog
feeds.description: The Werk! Place is a contemporary lifestyle brand dedicated to enhancing and highlighting the lifestyle of women through a fashion lens. The Werk! Place explores all aspects of today's woman. Whether it's personal style, travel, success, failure and transition, the motto is to 'Werk It!'.

feeds.title: Stylish By Nature
feeds.description: I am Shalini Chopra, a fashion, style and beauty blogger, from Bangalore, India. I buy in luxury boutiques but also in casual stores. My goal is to show you how we can be beautiful, trendy, stylish in every sense, pondering the purchase according to the latest trends of the moment !

feeds.title: Glitter & Gingham Blog
feeds.description: I'm Shelby. G&G is a southern life & style blog based in Lexington, KY where I share my latest outfit obsessions, current beauty favorites, my travel tidbits & everything in between.

feeds.title: Haute Off The Rack
feeds.description: Louisiana based fashion and lifestyle blogger Jennifer Palpallatoc of Haute Off The Rack strives to help women feel confident and beautiful in their clothing by sharing her personal style reviews while also educating her readers on new brands and trends. Her ultimate goal is to maximize her readers outfit options by presenting stylish new looks.

feeds.title: Flaunt and Center - A personal style blog
feeds.description: Flaunt and Center is a platform to help people feel inspired and a little more put together, so they can devote a lot more time in other areas of their life. So whether you're looking to find the perfect date night ensemble, or an outfit to wear to a Sunday brunch, no worries, I've got you covered.

feeds.title: Oh So Glam
feeds.description: Oh So Glam began in 2011 as a personal style blog and a way for Christina to connect with women to share her love of fashion. It has since turned into her full-time job and has expanded to include beauty, lifestyle, home decor, and world-wide travel.

feeds.title: The August Diaries
feeds.description: A visual diary where Jill Lansky shares her expert style tips and tricks, the latest trends, easy beauty tutorials, and travel guides. She empowers her readers to become the best version of themselves and use clothing as a means to gain confidence.

feeds.title: Foreign Fresh & Fierce Style
feeds.description: I write about fashion, my travels to other cities and countries, different cultures and foods that I have been able to experience and showcasing international style. With both fashion & travel, I love to show how you can dress stylishly and have an amazing time in beautiful destinations no matter your budget!

feeds.title: En Brogue
feeds.description: En Brogue is a blog about stylish flat shoes written and illustrated by Hannah Rochell, Fashion Features Editor at InStyle magazine in London. You'll find nothing on here but stylish flat shoes and inspiration on how to wear them, along with a few of my illustrations to boot.

feeds.title: Allyson in Wonderland
feeds.description: Ally of Allyson in Wonderland is a fashion, travel, and lifestyle blogger based out of Oklahoma City. This blog is her visual style story that showcases what to wear and where to wear it. Her goal is to expose readers to unique and accessible fashion ideas, dreamy places, and new beauty products to help inspire them on their own style journeys.

feeds.title: Tina Adams Consulting Blog
feeds.description: A style blog that connects you to real personal stylists. At Tina Adams Consulting, we are dedicated to helping women, men and teens build the perfect wardrobe over time with pieces you already own and adding only what is absolutely necessary.

feeds.title: The Wardrobe Stylist
feeds.description: Blogging came about in 2007. Eventually, I branded myself as The Wardrobe Stylist. I was fortunate enough to work with a long list of clients for photo shoots, ad campaigns, fashion events, and covered coveted fashion week events as a blogger.

feeds.title: My View in Heels
feeds.description: My name is Jaclyn, and I am a little taller than the average woman. My goal is to inspire you with the clothes I wear and experiences I have! I hope to bring a dose of my style and lifestyle to this blog.

feeds.title: Allie Wears
feeds.description: Allie Wears is a personal style blog showing you how to have fun with fashion without breaking the bank. The blog documents Allie's personal style, her passion for fashion, & her experience along the way.

feeds.title: RUN STYLE RUN
feeds.description: There's something about Brandi's style we can't quite put our finger on. Maybe it's the incredible vintage finds she lands, or how her looks are the perfect balance of simple and stunning. Whatever it is, she's good.

feeds.title: a fashion fiend
feeds.description: Catherine and her daughter, Taylor, are Arizona girls that started A Fashion Fiend. Catherine has always been a fashion enthusiast that was introduced to the fashion world by her Grandmother who shares the same passion.

feeds.title: Chic Talk
feeds.description: Hi there! I´m Carolina Hellal, a Colombian living in Denver, CO. For four years I have been working full-time as the creative director of Chic Talk, a blog that focuses on my personal style, love of fashion, beauty advice, travel adventures, and new life as a mom.

feeds.title: Whitney Nic James
feeds.description: I began blogging with one goal in mind - to document my personal style journey through thrifting. Todat WNJ has evolved into much more. Not only does does it showcase my personal style evolution, but it also serves as a source of inspiration for women all around the world.

feeds.title: StyleSpyGirl's Blog
feeds.description: StyleSpyGirl.com's mission is to help women cultivate their own personal style, by reporting on shopping, fashion, and beauty items that are both trendy and classy, encouraging individual taste, and educating women on how to embrace their own unique beauty.

feeds.title: Katie Like Me - Plus sized fashion and life.
feeds.description: I'm Katie, a twenty-four-year-old personal style blogger hailing from Indiana. Katie Like Me is an outlet of stylistic creativity geared towards those who love personal style, the fashion industry and day-to-day life.

feeds.title: TinuTrends Bringing Trends To Your Doorstep
feeds.description: My name is Atinuke Olubunmi Akindiya. I love keeping up with trending fashion styles, however, I personally define my fashion. My reason is simple, I believe that you don't have to follow the crowd. You can be unique, stand out and still be beautiful. Honestly if you do so, people will love you for it, many of them will imitate you and viola! You would have created your own fashion style. I know it sounds simple but that's because it is actually very simple.

feeds.title: Abbey Kay
feeds.description: A life, style, & encouragement blog by Abbey Kay.

feeds.title: One Dapper Street
feeds.description: This blog offers you guys interesting and relevant posts from dapper combinations to edgy streetwear and from daily outfit inspirations to curated shopping selections.

feeds.title: Looking Fly on a Dime
feeds.description: Affordable style expert helping women look their best, for less. Looking Fly on a Dime author. Thrift shopping pro. Glitter in my veins.

feeds.title: Modern Legacy
feeds.description: Modern Legacy is an australian fashion and personal style blog. Here you will find all the latest trends, style, quirky outfits and fashion reviews.

feeds.title: StyleSartor
feeds.description: StyleSartor is a digital fashion, beauty, and lifestyle destination featuring shoppable street-style galleries, high-low product roundups, seasonal trend reports, skincare and beauty tips, interviews with industry experts and influencers, and more.

feeds.title: ANDY HEART
feeds.description: Andy Heart is a blog founded by Ann Kim. With Fashion as focus it also covers lifestyle, art, design, and travel. Ann's minimalist sensibility and eye for balance and details are her signature in both her personal style and work.

feeds.title: Chic on the Cheap
feeds.description: Connecticut based personal style blog by Lydia Abate, based on a budget; because you should never sacrifice style for savings.

feeds.title: FIRE ON THE HEAD
feeds.description: Personal style blog of creative director and model Rima Vaidila. She shares a constant stream of day to day outfit updates, news and fashion trends, her thoughts and musings and much more.

feeds.title: Thrifts and Threads
feeds.description: I'm Brittany Xavier and I began my personal style blog. My style is versatile, casual, comfortable and a bit edgy. My blog first started out as only fashion but over the last three years so much of it really includes the lifestyle aspect of my everyday life. A blog to highlight my affordable finds as well as brands I find worth the splurge, those investment pieces I'll wear again and again.

feeds.title: The Wantable Style Blog
feeds.description: Wantable.com is an online lifestyle service for busy people on the go, providing premium products tailored to your unique tastes, wants, and needs. We'll select the perfect pieces and deliver them straight to your door each month. Build the wardrobe of your dreams. We're here to guide you every step of the way.

feeds.title: Kayture
feeds.description: Kristina is a stylist, influencer, model and creative director, constantly traveling around the world with her partner in crime James. Founded in 2011 by Kristina Bazan and her partner James Chardon, Kayture is the most influencial fashion blog in Switzerland, and one of the biggest names worldwide.

feeds.title: StyleCraze
feeds.description: Every woman's one-stop shop for advice on beauty, wellness and lifestyle! Whether it is makeup or skincare, hairstyle or health, we got it all here.

feeds.title: Ashley Weston
feeds.description: Ashley Weston is a top Celebrity Menswear Stylist and Men's Style Expert as well as a Contributing Fashion Editor for GQ International. In her day-to-day work as a Menswear Stylist, she has to dress her clients to look their absolute best in their personal lives and also in highly scrutinized situations like premieres, TV show appearances, magazine spreads and advertisements.

feeds.title: My Curves And Curls
feeds.description: Assa and love getting pretty, travelling and spending time with her family. She shares her personal style, hair , beauty, thrift finds, and shopping deals, style tips and more on her blog.

feeds.title: Nany's Klozet
feeds.description: Nany's Klozet is a Miami fashion blog by Daniela Ramirez featuring the latest fashion and beauty trends, local events, and personal style.

feeds.title: Happily Grey
feeds.description: Hi, I am mary. I think style encompasses more than just the clothes you see. The way one walks, talks,stands, and most importantly, the confidence all create style. I am no fashion expert. I am learning and evolving more everyday as Happily Grey grows in its own way.

feeds.title: Caroline Broome
feeds.description: I am Caroline. I began LCB STYLE as a creative outlet during my freshman year of college as a fashion design major, and when my college path took a non traditional turn (read the full story here), this space grew into so much more! Since 2015, I have been creating fashion, travel, and beauty stories to share with my readers and friends here on LCBSTYLE.COM.

feeds.title: Sweenee Style Blog
feeds.description: Sweenee Style is a blog that is dedicated to sharing my personal style, outfit ideas, diy's, helpful hints and fun! My style is affordable yet classy. I personally think it doesn't take a lot of money or designer labels to be well dressed.

feeds.title: Dash of Darling
feeds.description: Dash of Darling is a personal style blog curated by Caitlin who shares her fashion finds, beauty tips, and decor favorites one photo at a time.

feeds.title: Nadia Aboulhosn Blog
feeds.description: She's a style icon for girls with curves, pouring her figure into everything from minis to bodycon dresses to short shorts and thigh-high gladiators with more confidence than J-Lo. The entire concept of her blog is fearlessness, being comfortable with who you are and what you wear.
